careers.title: Jonin-Level Frontend Developer
careers.description: As a Jonin-level Frontend Developer, you will be responsible for crafting high-performance web interfaces with precision, speed, and ninja-like efficiency. Your expertise in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks will help shape the future of shinobi technology.
requirements: Proficiency in React, Vue, or Angular
Mastery of responsive design techniques
Experience with UI/UX principles and animation effects
Ability to work in a fast-paced ninja environment

careers.title: Ramen Quality Specialist
careers.description: Join Ichiraku Ramen as a Ramen Quality Specialist, ensuring every bowl is crafted to perfection. Taste, analyze, and enhance flavors while upholding the legendary reputation of Konoha's favorite ramen spot.
requirements: Exceptional taste buds and food critique skills
Deep passion for ramen and culinary arts
Ability to work long hours in a high-energy kitchen
Chakra control for precise ingredient measurement (preferred)

careers.title: Chunin-Rank Strategist
careers.description: Serve as a Chunin-Rank Strategist, developing tactical battle plans and optimizing mission outcomes. Work alongside elite shinobi to predict enemy movements and ensure successful operations.
requirements: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in war tactics and battlefield strategies
Ability to work under pressure during high-stakes missions
Experience with information-gathering and reconnaissance

careers.title: ANBU Intelligence Officer
careers.description: As an ANBU Intelligence Officer, you will operate in the shadows, gathering classified information and conducting top-secret investigations for Konoha’s safety. Discretion, speed, and strategic thinking are essential.
requirements: Mastery of stealth and infiltration techniques
Ability to decrypt coded messages and gather intelligence
Strong mental resilience and unwavering loyalty
Experience in high-risk, high-reward missions

careers.title: Taijutsu Instructor
careers.description: Train the next generation of taijutsu masters under the guidance of legendary warriors. Inspire students to unlock the Eight Gates and push their physical limits beyond the norm.
requirements: Exceptional hand-to-hand combat skills
Passion for teaching and mentoring young shinobi
Ability to demonstrate advanced taijutsu techniques
Endurance to train in extreme conditions

careers.title: Medical Ninja Specialist
careers.description: As a Medical Ninja Specialist, you will heal wounded shinobi on the battlefield and within the hospital. Advanced chakra control and deep medical knowledge are required to save lives.
requirements: Expertise in medical ninjutsu and chakra healing
Knowledge of human anatomy and advanced medicine
Ability to remain calm under pressure
Experience with poison antidotes and emergency treatments

careers.title: Chakra Flow Engineer
careers.description: Design and optimize chakra-based technology to enhance shinobi abilities. Work with elite scientists to develop groundbreaking tools that push the limits of jutsu efficiency.
requirements: Deep understanding of chakra theory and energy flow
Experience with engineering and technological enhancements
Creativity in designing new ninja tools and techniques
Collaboration with research teams on experimental projects
